name: services-management-mern
description: Root convenience scripts for running client + server together during development. Each app is still deployed separately - see docs/PRD-MERN-Migration.md section 9.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.start: npm install --prefix server && npm run build --prefix server && npm start --prefix server
